title: 第19章 怪物第20章 小咔
content_zh:
不知道过了多久……
突然，一种难以言喻的感觉惊醒了凯撒，不是声音，也不是触碰，更像是一种…被什么东西近距离注视着的直觉！
凯撒猛地睁开眼！
一张纯白毫无瑕疵的脸，几乎贴到他鼻尖上！
距离近得连对方脸上细微的绒毛都看得清清楚楚！
那双眼睛，没有瞳孔，或者说整个眼球都是毫无杂质的蓝白色，正直勾勾地盯着他！
“我——！
！”
凯撒根本来不及思考这是什么魔物，身体已经先于意识做出了反应。
蜷缩的双腿猛地爆发出最后的力量，狠狠朝那张近在咫尺的瓷白脸庞蹬了过去！
“砰！”
一声闷响，凯撒感觉脚底踹在了一个冰冷但又有弹性的物体上。
借着这股反冲力，他手脚并用地从地上弹了起来，迅速爬地冲出那个小凹陷，头也不回地朝着冰窟深处没命地狂奔！
“什么鬼东西！”
凯撒根本不敢回头，只听到身后传来一阵“咔嚓”
声，像是锋利的指甲刮过冰面的声音，而且那声音正在飞快地接近！
凯撒在奇形怪状的冰柱之间来回穿梭，冰面滑得要命，好几次他都差点摔倒，全靠手里的铁矛勉强撑住，他回头飞快地瞥了一眼。
只见那个“东西”
速度极快，而且追的方式极其诡异！
那根本不是跑，而是一种四肢着的快速爬行，但动作又异常流畅协调。

它浑身赤裸，皮肤白得晃眼，在幽蓝的冰光下像一道幽灵。
同样是近乎纯白的长发在爬行中飘散开来，那对蓝白色的眼睛死死锁定着他。
里面没有愤怒，没有杀意，只有一种…纯粹的好奇和…兴奋？
凯撒玩命的跑，哪里冰缝狭窄就往哪里钻，希望能利用地形甩掉这个怪物。
凯撒甚至试图把挡路的碎冰块踢向身后，但是完全没有作用，它的身影灵活至极地在冰柱间穿梭，速度丝毫未减。
“这样跑下去不是办法！”
凯撒迅速冲进一个相对开阔，但三面都是高大冰壁的区域。
身后那刺耳的刮冰声瞬间到了身后！
凯撒猛地转身，背靠着冰冷的岩壁，双手死死攥住铁矛，矛尖对准那个停在几步开外的白色身影。
content_en:
I don’t know how long it has been...
Suddenly, an indescribable feeling woke Caesar up. It was not a sound or a touch, but more like an intuition... of being watched at close range by something!
Caesar opened his eyes suddenly!
A pure white and flawless face, almost touching the tip of his nose!
The distance is so close that you can clearly see the fine hair on the other person's face!
Those eyes had no pupils, or the entire eyeballs were impure blue-white, staring straight at him!
"I-!
! "
Caesar didn't even have time to think about what kind of monster it was, because his body had already reacted before his consciousness.
The curled-up legs suddenly burst out with the last strength, and kicked hard towards the porcelain white face that was so close at hand!
"Bang!"
There was a muffled sound, and Caesar felt his foot hit a cold but elastic object.
With the help of this recoil, he jumped up from the ground on his hands and feet, quickly crawled out of the small depression, and ran towards the depths of the ice cave without looking back!
"What the hell!"
Caesar didn't dare to look back at all, he only heard a "click" coming from behind him
The sound was like the sound of sharp nails scraping across the ice, and the sound was approaching quickly!
Caesar shuttled back and forth between the strange-shaped icicles. The ice was so slippery that he almost fell down several times. He only managed to hold on with the iron spear in his hand. He glanced back quickly.
I only see that "thing"
The speed is extremely fast, and the way of chasing is extremely weird!
It was not running at all, but a fast crawling on all fours, but the movements were extremely smooth and coordinated.
It was naked and its skin was dazzlingly white, looking like a ghost under the blue ice light.
The same long, almost pure white hair spread out while crawling, and those blue-white eyes were locked on him.
There was no anger, no murderous intent, just... pure curiosity and... excitement?
Caesar ran as fast as he could, burrowing wherever the ice cracks were narrow, hoping to use the terrain to get rid of this monster.
Caesar even tried to kick the broken ice blocks behind him, but it had no effect at all. Its figure shuttled between the icicles extremely flexibly without slowing down at all.
"There's no way to keep running like this!"
Caesar quickly rushed into an area that was relatively open but surrounded by tall ice walls on three sides.
The harsh sound of scraping ice came behind me instantly!
Caesar turned around suddenly, leaning against the cold rock wall, holding on to the iron spear with both hands, and pointed the tip of the spear at the white figure stopped a few steps away.
